{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Cobra''''' was the name of a group of four Corellian [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] that were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They were part of an [[Defense of ZA-13|Attack]] on [[ZA-13]] but, despite fighter escort and equipped with missile launchers they were all destroyed by [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]], one of which was piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
